proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the map (t, g) -> (t, m(psi(t), g)) is an isomorphism onto its target arrangement and the square with projection T x_S G -> T over S is cartesian, so the action-type morphism T x_S G -> G is the base change of the flat morphism T -> S along the projection, hence flat by the cited morphisms lemma; taking T = G and psi = identity gives flatness of m (source lines 836-851)
